_note: overpowers: castes this one beats by toughness and trample rather than frenzy (big units; shown as a counter like outnumbers). trample: when a bite kills, its leftover damage carries on into up to this many more enemies (big units, docs/08-combat.md). corpseCargo: corpses carried home straight from a won raid (Slave-maker). role: worker, soldier, scout, carrier, queen or wild (NPC-only); screens group castes by it, e.g. the nest draws one guard per soldier. blurb: the field-guide line shown in the Brood Hall. outnumbers: castes this one beats by sheer numbers at equal cost rather than by frenzy (shown as a counter in the Brood Hall and battle reports, docs/05-castes-units.md). npcOnly castes live only in NPC colonies (docs/24-npcs.md): players never raise them. health defaults to (foliage + protein) / 10. speed in map units/hour (see formulas.json). frenzy: chance to fire again = (N-1)/N vs that target.

worker.name: Worker
worker.blurb: Cheap all-rounders. Carry loot and haul corpses.

minor_soldier.name: Minor Soldier
minor_soldier.blurb: Fast and cheap. In numbers they swarm and pull down Major Soldiers, as Pheidole minors gang up on big intruders.

scout.name: Scout
scout.blurb: Spies on other colonies. Nearly useless in a fight.

major_soldier.name: Major Soldier
major_soldier.blurb: Big-headed and armoured. Crush Acid Sprayers and Trap-jaw Ants, but drown under a swarm of Minor Soldiers.

hauler.name: Hauler
hauler.blurb: Big carriers for loot, transports and corpses.

winged_queen.name: Winged Queen
winged_queen.blurb: Flies off to found a new colony. Tap an empty spot in Missions and send her with a Found colony mission.

acid_sprayer.name: Acid Sprayer
acid_sprayer.blurb: Formica soldiers spray formic acid over a crowd. They mow down Minor Soldiers and Workers, but die fast to Major Soldiers.

trap_jaw.name: Trap-jaw Ant
trap_jaw.blurb: Jaws locked open at 180°, snapping shut faster than anything in nature. They tear apart defenses, but are fragile against ants: send them with an escort.

supermajor.name: Supermajor
supermajor.blurb: Leafcutter supermajors with heads like boulders. Slow and hugely tough, they trample through Major Soldiers and Acid Sprayers; a swarm of Minors or a Bullet Ant brings them down.

slave_maker.name: Slave-maker
slave_maker.blurb: Polyergus raiders with sickle jaws. They cannot even feed themselves, but on a won raid they carry the dead home at once, before anyone else can haul them.

desert_ant.name: Desert Ant
desert_ant.blurb: Cataglyphis forage in the midday heat and find their way home by the sun. Fast, and every few in a forage party improve its luck.

gardener_minim.name: Gardener Minim
gardener_minim.blurb: The tiniest leafcutters, who weed and tend the fungus garden. Each one at home makes the Leaf Gardens a little richer, up to a limit per Leaf Garden level.

carrion_beetle.name: Carrion Beetle
carrion_beetle.blurb: A burying beetle that lives with the colony and hauls corpses by the ton. It cannot fight.

assassin_bug.name: Assassin Bug
assassin_bug.blurb: A predatory bug that stabs through any armour with its beak. Deadly to beetles and Supermajors, but fragile: small ants overwhelm it.

bullet_ant.name: Bullet Ant
bullet_ant.blurb: A giant rainforest ant with the most painful sting of any insect. It hunts big targets (Majors, Supermajors, beetles) but a swarm of Minors pulls it down.

rhino_beetle.name: Rhinoceros Beetle
rhino_beetle.blurb: The biggest thing in the leaf litter, able to lift hundreds of times its weight. It ploughs through ranks of ants; only Assassin Bugs and Bullet Ants can stop it.

termite_worker.name: Termite Worker
termite_worker.blurb: Soft, pale termites that chew wood into the mound.

termite_soldier.name: Termite Soldier
termite_soldier.blurb: Armoured termites with huge jaws that guard the mound.

spiderling.name: Spiderling
spiderling.blurb: A young trapdoor spider, already quick to bite.

trapdoor_spider.name: Trapdoor Spider
trapdoor_spider.blurb: She waits under a silk lid and kills an ant with every strike.
